comparison_set.description: No sufficiently documented local and cross-city reference set has been assembled for this concept yet.
comparison_set.method: Before scoring novelty, compare at least three documented precedents or prior concepts with explicit context and source links; record similarities and differences.
limitations: Novelty has not been assessed; absence of a comparison set must not be interpreted as proof that the idea is original.

life_safety.rationale: No site-specific safety or engineering review has been performed.

accessibility.rationale: No local disabled-user review or measured route audit has been performed.

rights_and_consent.rationale: No community authorship, cultural rights, or consent process has taken place.

environmental_and_land_feasibility.rationale: No site-specific utility, soil, contamination, flood, or ecological assessment has been performed.

operating_owner_and_funding.rationale: No named delivery owner, operating plan, or maintenance budget has been established.

anti_displacement.rationale: No housing-tenure, trader-livelihood, or displacement-impact assessment has been performed.

privacy_and_data_minimization.rationale: No operational data flow or privacy review has been performed.

limitations: This is a protocol-only fixture, not a completed review or a claim of community endorsement.
The rubric has not been calibrated in Johannesburg through paid local review or observed outcomes.
No single weighted creativity score is defined; individual dimensions and dissent remain visible.
